verdict.rationale: No evidence addresses build or type-check time scaling in large multi-thousand-component codebases or monorepos; docs mention CLI build/serve commands and persistent disk caching but give no benchmarks or scaling data, and community evidence about performance concerns (angular-comm-6, angular-comm-10, angular-comm-12) refers to old AngularJS digest-cycle runtime performance, not build/type-check compile times.
